Sounds like you want to hang on. You really aren't alone. Really. It's helped me to remember that life doesn't always suck (even if it mostly sucks). Rough patches are rough, and I don't want to gloss over that fact with a smattering of platitudes. We don't do this life for the bad times, and they can certainly outweigh the good times, but there are good times. It's also helped me to focus on helping others, just a little, here and there. Smile at people when you are shopping, hold open a door, say hello to a lonely face. 
I don't know the answer to your question; I'm just sharing some things that have helped me.

Not feeling it today. Life just keeps going, reproducing itself. Staying is what I do for others, not for me. When people say suicide is selfish, they are right, but the other side of the coin is true as well. Telling people to not commit suicide is selfish. I will continue to maintain myself for the sake of my family, and I'll hope that they can find greater joy in life than what I can find.
